author: soraboss
body:
Hey sorry that I have to waste someone's time on this but..

I'm soraboss (ign) and I was banned for "Toggle aimbot" by kycrafft on july, 4 2015 4:05:36 AM.

Now I wish to get this ban removed or what ever the best thing is because i love your server, I've been an on off member for about 2 years and I can't find any game like yours. I'm sorry that I was using "toggle aimbot" if only I did. How ever I don't. I will admit that before playing on your server I have used hacks before, but once I turned them off I realized my skill at pvp had vanished. so after years of pvp training I have become legitimate. I regret those days I did hack, I'm a changed man now. I have never used hacks on your sever and I say that with respect and truth. I wish I had taken screen shots, to show you. Or video footage, but I run the game on a basic laptop that lags here and there. I believe if I did appear to use this type of hack it could be due to my delay. (one guy has told me he can't hit me sometimes because of me lagging, I think it would be the other way round, but I don't really know much). I trained for this so much and you guys are taking this away from me, when there are lots of people better than me. Take it this way, if I was hacking wouldn't it be like impossible to kill me? Again i'm sorry for the confusion, but I beg you to please do something in my favor. Love you long time? - soraboss
